name: Justin Gaethje

face.shape: Broad, square-to-rectangular face that reads short and wide. Widest at the cheekbones and jaw, with little taper to the chin. Above the ears the skull is rounded, and in profile the head is fairly long front to back.
face.jaw: Wide and heavy. The jaw angles sit far out under the ears and are rounded off by the beard. The jaw line runs almost straight into a very thick neck, so there is little visible narrowing below the ears.
face.chin: Broad, moderately projecting chin, hidden under the beard. In profile (CBS photo) it sits roughly in line with the lower lip, neither receding nor jutting.
face.cheekbones: Wide-set but not sharply defined. The cheeks are full and fleshy below the cheekbones, more so in the off-camp May 2026 photo than at fight weight.
face.brow_ridge: Moderately prominent and heavy. It shades the eyes and makes them look slightly deep-set, especially under top light (weigh-in, Oval Office group).
face.forehead: Broad and medium-to-tall, with three or four clear horizontal creases (moderate depth in the studio stance crop, deeper when he looks down in the Oval Office group photo). The hairline recedes at the temples, which makes the forehead look taller at the sides.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped with a narrow vertical opening. The upper lids are heavy and hooded, and the lower lids are slightly puffy. Outer corners are level to slightly downturned.
eyes.colour: Light blue-grey with a slight green tint (grey-green-blue in both studio portraits, grey-blue in arena light). Closest embed iris: mh-iris-grey or mh-iris-blue tinted toward grey-green.
eyes.size: Look small for the face because of the hooded lids and the broad surrounding face.

eyebrows.shape: Low-set and fairly straight, with a slight peak about two-thirds of the way out and tails that drop a little. They sit close to the eyes.
eyebrows.colour: Light brown with a ginger tinge, lighter than the head hair and darker than the beard (sample about #a97866 in studio light).

nose.width: Wide through its whole length; this is the most distinctive feature of the face.
nose.bridge: Broad and flattened from the frontal view, wider at mid-bridge than an undamaged nose. In three-quarter views (fence and 2022 photos) the mid-bridge is lumpy and irregular rather than a clean line.
nose.hump: No classic dorsal hump. The profile is fairly straight to slightly flat, with small irregular bumps at mid-bridge.
nose.tip: Broad, rounded and somewhat bulbous, pointing slightly downward.
nose.fight_damage: Yes, visibly. The flattened, widened bridge and lumpy mid-section look like repeated breaks. A fresh cut on the bridge shows in the UFC 324 post-fight photo. Depending on the photo the nose can look very slightly off-centre, but not consistently, so model it symmetric.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, with a flat cupid's bow; partly covered by the moustache.
mouth.lower_lip: Medium fullness, fuller than the upper lip.
mouth.resting_expression: Lips closed and neutral, corners level to slightly down. When he smiles it is often a closed-mouth smirk with the lips pressed together (Oval Office).
mouth.teeth: Straight, even upper teeth when he smiles (2022 presser, Gators).

ears.protrusion: Stand slightly out from the head; easy to see from the front because the sides of the head are clipped short.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Mild at most. The left ear shows some thickening and irregular folds in the upper concha and antihelix (studio headshot, 2022 presser) and had a small cut on the rim in fight-night photos. The right ear looks closer to normal (CBS profile). Neither ear is heavily swollen.
ears.notes: None of the photos is sharp enough to model the ear cartilage in detail; treat the ears as normal with slightly thick rims.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large permanent facial scars visible at these resolutions. A faint thin line runs across the left cheekbone in the Oval Office photo; it is not visible in the other photos, so it could be a skin crease or an old healed cut, and should not be modelled. The 2022 presser shows a small red spot inside the left ear (a scab or cut). There are deep horizontal forehead creases and some redness and rough texture over the nose and cheeks. Fight-night photos show temporary cuts on the nose bridge and left ear, which should not be modelled as permanent.

hair.style: Short tapered or faded cut. The sides and back are clipped very short, close to skin at the bottom and blending to about 1 cm higher up. The top is about 4-5 cm, textured, pushed up and forward with no strong part. The front is brushed up slightly; there is no fringe.
hair.colour: Medium brown, warm to ash, with lighter golden-brown tips under bright light. Clearly darker and less red than the beard. It reads darker brown when styled wet with product (Lincoln Memorial, June 2026) and more auburn under warm light (2022 presser), so do not tint it from a single photo.
hair.hairline: Receding at both temples (mild M shape), with the central forelock intact. Hair is still dense on top; no crown thinning visible.
hair.texture: Straight to slightly wavy and fairly coarse. It goes wavy or curly on top when sweaty (UFC 324 fence photo).
hair.notes: Often wears a white baseball cap in public (weigh-in, Gators interview) and a black UFC beanie under the hood on fight night.

facial_hair.colour: Copper-ginger red, noticeably redder and lighter than the head hair, with a few lighter blond or white hairs at the chin corners in the studio headshot.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, moustache and jaw line, thinner and patchier on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 8-12 mm in the 2026 fight-week and studio photos, about 6-10 mm in August 2026, and trimmed to heavy stubble (about 3-5 mm) in the May 2026 Oval Office photo.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache. The natural cheek line sits low, about level with the bottom of the nose. The neckline is low, running onto the upper neck under the jaw. The chin is rounded off, not pointed.

indoor daylight, partly under cap brim

skin.review_cross_check_note: Independent 9x9-pixel median samples taken in review. They agree with the original samples, with an average a little darker because two of them sit in the cap shadow in the Gators photo. tone_hex #dc9b8b is kept. Studio forehead points hit specular highlights (#fbccbc), so do not use them.
skin.undertone: Warm-pink, ruddy. He flushes easily: cheeks, nose and ears go noticeably red in daylight and under stage light.
skin.freckles_marks: Fair skin with light freckling and sun-flush on the forehead, shoulders and upper arms. Light reddish-blond body hair on the forearms and legs, and sparse chest hair.
skin.texture_pick: Start from the middleage_caucasian_male skin and tint it warmer and pinker toward #dc9b8b, adding a stronger red flush over the cheeks and nose.

body.build: Compact, dense and muscular for a lightweight; a thick wrestler's frame rather than a long, rangy one. Reach (70 in) is an inch shorter than his height, so the arms are slightly short for his frame.
body.body_fat_notes: Lean but not shredded in the fight-week and studio photos (faint four-pack outline, no deep cuts). Off camp (May and August 2026) the face and waist are visibly fuller.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad with well-rounded deltoids and high, thick trapezius muscles that slope steeply into the neck.
body.chest: Moderately developed and fairly flat pecs; not bulky.
body.arms: Strong upper arms with well-developed biceps, triceps and deltoids, thick forearms and visible veins. Athletic, not bodybuilder-sized.
body.waist: Thick and blocky through the obliques and lower back, so the V-taper is only mild. The abdomen is flat with a faint outline.
body.legs_calves: Thick, powerful thighs with clear quad sweep and well-developed calves. Legs are of average length for his height and carry light reddish hair.
body.neck: Very thick and wide; from the front it is close to the width of the jaw.
body.posture: Upright with the chin slightly tucked and the head a little forward; shoulders slightly raised and rounded by the heavy traps. Fights from an orthodox stance.
body.notable_physique_traits: Thick neck and traps, wide jaw, dense wrestler's trunk, strong legs. The silhouette reads short and powerful rather than tall.

tattoos.where: Right upper arm, outer side, between shoulder and elbow
tattoos.description: Ornate gothic-style cross in black and blue-grey with flared, flourished ends and a ribbon or vine winding through it
tattoos.size: About 15 cm tall x 8 cm wide

tattoos.where: Right side of the torso, from just below the right pec down to the waistband, from the flank almost to the navel
tattoos.description: Large traditional-style colour piece. A winged warrior in a Spartan or Greek helmet with a red crest wields a sword, beside a second dark-haired figure holding a round studded shield, with grey smoke shading. Two banners read 'BEFORE' (upper right of the piece) and 'DISHONOR' (lower left). Colours: black outlines, red, orange and skin tones, grey and blue-grey.
tattoos.size: About 25 cm tall x 18 cm wide

tattoos.where: Left side of the ribcage, below and outside the left pec, toward the flank
tattoos.description: Small black line-work curl. From the front (studio stance, weigh-in) it looks like a hook or a small bird; from the side (UFC 324 fence photo) it reads as an eye-like swirl with a curled tail. No colour.
tattoos.size: About 5 cm tall x 8-10 cm wide

tattoos.where: Back of the left shoulder (rear deltoid / top of the shoulder blade)
tattoos.description: Small black outline tattoo, only partly visible at the edge of the shoulder in the UFC 324 fence photo: an elongated looped line. None of the photos shows his back, so its full design and size are unknown.
tattoos.size: Unknown (the visible part is about 6-8 cm long)

accessories_seen: Silver cross pendant on a chain (weigh-in, 2022 presser), a thin chain and a large steel wristwatch on the left wrist in daily wear, a white baseball cap, and a thin multicoloured string bracelet on the left wrist at the June 2026 weigh-in.

kit.typical_shorts: Black UFC-issued fight shorts. Two white diagonal stripes, a vertical UFC wordmark and the crypto.com logo all sit on his RIGHT hip and thigh (viewer's left when he faces the camera), with a UFC wordmark on the front of the waistband just to his left of centre. The official studio portrait (early 2025 or before) has a tonal dark grey stars-and-stripes print. At UFC 324 (Jan 2026) the black shorts had a tonal pattern and a green Monster Energy claw logo, also on his right thigh. At UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026) the shorts were white with thin light-blue diagonal lines, matching the walkout jersey.
kit.gloves: Standard UFC 4 oz gloves with corner-coloured cuffs: red cuffs at UFC 324, blue 'Freedom 250' gloves at the White House event (June 2026).
kit.walkout: UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026): navy hood with red and white trim, black UFC beanie, white/light-blue patterned walkout jersey with a crypto.com logo, US flag over the shoulders. At the weigh-in: navy UFC track pants, white cap.
kit.brand_note: No apparel brand logo is legible on the shorts in these photos; describe them as UFC-issued.

eyes: blue-grey with a slight green tint.

2026-11-06 avatar pass 2: tuned with tests/likeness_compare.js against ref-espn-headshot.png (front): wider and shorter face, smaller hooded eyes (upper lid lowered with the newly baked eye-height1 target), protruding ears and a wider, flatter nose (community elvs_nose_widening_1); ear values from morphs_not_in_embed now apply directly.
review.likeness_pass_2026_11_06_v4: Eyes opened (smaller eye-height and eye-scale decreases), cheek volume and face fat reduced so the face reads square rather than puffy, nose lengthened, after side-by-side renders against ref-espn-headshot.png.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin, tattoos and overall build; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 14 usable photos (9 Commons PD/CC BY-SA, 5 reference-only), 12 of them from 2026, so recent coverage is good. The weak point is a true side profile: the only one (CBS, Aug 2026) is about 70 degrees and under a cap, and the face-off profile has a microphone over the nose. Frontal shape is driven by the UFC studio headshot plus the Oval Office photo. What to watch: (1) The likeness depends on the broad, flattened nose, wide jaw and very thick neck; if the nose is too narrow or the neck too thin it stops looking like him. (2) The beard must be clearly redder (copper) than the medium-brown head hair; this colour split is a strong recognition cue. (3) Keep the eyes small and hooded under a low, heavy brow; default MakeHuman eyes look too open. (4) Skin should be fair and ruddy, with extra red on the nose and cheeks; do not use a neutral beige. (5) Hair is a short fade with a 4-5 cm textured top and receding temples; short02 or short04 tinted #5e4536 is the closest proxy, but check the temple recession. (6) The 'BEFORE / DISHONOR' warrior piece on the right side and the cross on the right upper arm are the signature tattoos; mirror-check them, because both are on HIS right side (viewer's left when he faces the camera). (7) Body: lean, wrestler-thick trunk, mild V, big legs; at fight weight do not make him bulky in the chest. Macro values: ageOldM uses MakeHuman's 25-years-at-0.5, 90-years-at-1.0 mapping (age 37, turning 38 on 2026-11-14). heightUpM 0.1 is a guess for about 180 cm, so scale the final mesh to 180.3 cm if the avatar code supports it. MakeHuman l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left and right; the values here are symmetric.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/justin-gaethje.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (ref-espn-stance.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Wide, low, fairly square stance (squared up to throw and check calf kicks), high tight guard with elbows in, walks forward flat-footed and bobs his head behind the guard.

ethnicity_fit.method: Fitted by eye with tests/likeness_compare.js on 2026-11-06: the neutral MakeHuman thirds and a 0.15/0.15/0.7 trial were rendered front, 3/4 and profile at the headshot's framing. The trial narrowed the cheeks and jaw, while his face is broad and square, so the neutral blend fits better and is kept. Shape bases only; skin colour comes from the tone samples.
